comparison.objective: Stretch a rubber band around three pegs; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable stretching, routing, and tension management versus rigid tool engagement, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Band must encircle all three pegs; candidate requires safe repeated carriage stops and setting retention. Setup and scoring fields are missing.
comparison.reason: Deformable routing and tension control are meaningfully different from rigid-body adjustment and dynamic damper validation.
